products.name: HV0 Rechargeable Kit
products.description:
Directions

Insert HealthVape's nic-free HV0 pods into the top of the battery. The battery will activate automatically when you inhale and will deactivate when you stop inhaling. When the battery flashes, attach a USB-C charger cord to the bottom of the battery to start charging. (We don’t include a charging cord to reduce electronic waste)

While the device is charging, the indicator light will slowly flash and will stop flashing when the device is fully charged.

This rechargeable battery is easy to use and connects to HealthVape's HV0 vitamin-infused pods.

Technical Specifications

7.62 x 1.27 x 2.54 cm
600mAh Battery
Mesh Coil 1.2Ω
USB-C Rapid Charging
Clear Indicator Light
Textured Grip Surface

The REST Melatonin Bundle brings together three of our peppermint-and-cassia melatonin inhalers — the perfect companion to your evening ritual after a long day. Sit back, take a slow breath, and melt into the night. Each REST formula is nicotine-free, USP-grade, plant-based, vegan and 3rd-party lab tested with no artificial additives. Bundle up and save 17%. 🌙

This 6-pen variety bundle pairs our citrus ENERGY (caffeine + B12) with our berry-mint FOCUS (Vitamin B12 + B6), so you've got a refreshing lift and a clear head whenever you need it. All nicotine-free, USP-grade, plant-based and 3rd-party lab tested with zero artificial additives. Six refreshing pens at 20% off versus buying separately. ⚡✨
